parameters.name: products
parameters.description: Finite set of products, indexed by p

parameters.name: planning_periods
parameters.description: Finite set of planning periods, indexed by t

parameters.name: machines
parameters.description: Finite set of machines, indexed by m

parameters.name: base_product
parameters.description: Distinguished base product in the technical mix rule

parameters.name: support_product
parameters.description: Distinguished support product in the technical mix rule

parameters.name: processing_time
parameters.description: Processing time per unit of each product on its designated machine

parameters.name: available_effective_machine_time
parameters.description: Available effective machine time for each machine and period

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.description: Ratio parameter in the technical mix rule

parameters.name: beta
parameters.description: Ratio parameter in the technical mix rule

parameters.name: demand_limit
parameters.description: Optional external demand limit for each product and period

parameters.name: unit_cost
parameters.description: Optional unit cost for each product

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of product p produced and sold in period t

variables.name: total_profit
variables.description: Total profit over the planning horizon

constraints.name: machine_time_capacity
constraints.description: For each machine and period, the total effective time used by products assigned to that machine cannot exceed the available effective machine time.

constraints.name: technical_mix_rule
constraints.description: The total quantity of the support product must be at least the required minimum proportion relative to the total quantity of the base product over the planning horizon.

constraints.name: demand_limit_upper_bound
constraints.description: If optional demand limits are provided, production-and-sales quantities for each product and period must not exceed the corresponding demand limit.

constraints.name: nonnegativity_of_production
constraints.description: Production-and-sales quantities must be nonnegative for all products and periods.

constraints.name: integrality_of_production
constraints.description: Production-and-sales quantities must be integer-valued for all products and periods when discrete production is required.

objectives.name: total_profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total profit over the full planning horizon based on production-and-sales quantities and unit profits

final_objective.description: Maximize total profit over the full planning horizon by summing unit profit times production-and-sales quantity across all products and periods.
